Asset type: original production isometric RTS naval unit sprite atlas; landscape 2:1 canvas, 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, real transparent RGBA.

Render the SAME compact modern carrier in eight distinct yaw angles under one fixed orthographic camera elevated 45 degrees. Matte naval graphite-gray hull and deck, small white and muted ochre runway markings, starboard bridge island with antennas and blue-tinted windows, a few small parked ivory-gray jets along the deck edges. Fine readable miniature 3D detail, soft neutral daylight. No red hull stripe, no gold outlines.
Exact directions in row order: top E (pointed bow RIGHT, flat stern LEFT); NE (bow UPPER RIGHT, stern lower left); N (bow UP away, stern nearest viewer); NW (bow UPPER LEFT). Bottom W (bow LEFT); SW (bow LOWER LEFT); S (bow DOWN toward viewer); SE (bow LOWER RIGHT toward viewer). Physically rotate the entire same ship; never mirror an existing render. Keep the bridge on the ship's starboard side in every yaw.
Each complete ship including antennas must fit within the central 66 percent of its own square cell, exactly centered. Same camera, physical scale, light and design across all eight views; front/rear views naturally narrow. Generous fully transparent gutters on every side of every cell. No silhouette touches or crosses a cell boundary.
Alpha ZERO in all empty pixels. Neutral antialiased edges, no white or colored matte. No background, white canvas, fake checkerboard, ground shadow, cast shadow, sea, waves, wake, smoke, firing, explosions, labels, text, grid lines, scenery or UI. Only eight clean isolated carrier sprites.
